function.name: Customer service
function.description: Answering, routing and resolving customer requests after the sale.

jobs.name: Resolve tier-1 support requests without a human
jobs.outcome: A routine customer request (password reset, order status, how-do-I) is answered correctly and closed with no person handling it.

jobs.name: Flag customers likely to leave from their interactions
jobs.outcome: Accounts whose conversations, usage and tone point to churn are flagged early enough to act.

jobs.name: Draft replies a support agent sends with light edits
jobs.outcome: A support agent receives a drafted reply grounded in the customer's history and the knowledge base and sends it with minor edits or none.

jobs.name: Score every support interaction against the quality rubric
jobs.outcome: Each interaction receives a quality score consistent with a trained reviewer's, so coaching needs no sampling.

jobs.name: Summarize a customer conversation for the next handler
jobs.outcome: A conversation of any length is condensed into what was asked, what was done and what is open, and the next handler needs nothing else.

jobs.name: Route incoming tickets to the right queue
jobs.outcome: Every new ticket lands in the queue and priority a trained agent would have chosen, before a person reads it.
